title: The Ph. Eur. monograph attached later in this same document names four specified impurities (A, B, C, D) for Estradiol hemihydrate, but the internal Related Compounds specification (01-1548-RC) and its vendor/EP/IUPAC name-mapping table define a test and limit for only three (D, B, A) -- Impurity C has no corresponding test, limit, or mapping entry anywhere in the document
evidence_anchor: Specified impurities: A, B, C, D.
section_hint: p.12 IMPURITIES / p.4 Related Compounds (01-1548-RC) / p.5 vendor-name table

title: The internal Water <921> Method I criterion is a one-sided ceiling ('NMT 3.5%.') with no lower bound, while the Ph. Eur. monograph for the same hemihydrate substance, included later in this document, specifies a two-sided range ('2.9 per cent to 3.5 per cent') -- the internal spec would pass a sample far below the hemihydrate's expected water content
section_hint: p.3 Water test row / p.12 Ph. Eur. Water (2.5.12)

title: The Assay row's acceptance range (97.0%-103.0%) is defined 'calculated on the anhydrous basis,' but the same cell also instructs 'Report assay on as is basis' -- no acceptance criterion for the as-is-basis value is defined anywhere in the specification
evidence_anchor: Report assay on as is basis.
